selection_rule: Within the supplied 200 tasks: reference.st physical line count descending; original task ID ascending for ties; first 100
line_count_definition: len(UTF-8 reference.st text.splitlines()); includes declarations, comments and blank lines
selected_by: reference length only; no model outcome used
historical_exposure: Selected from an existing training pool; not claimed as a pristine unseen holdout.
replacement_reason: User requested the 100 longest reference programs from the existing 200-task pool.
